ownTitle: This country's own (country_tag = {tag}). Affects only the current country — safe to edit.
explicitTitle: Cross-country shared (shared_country_tags = {tags}). Editing affects all of these countries at once.
globalTitle: Global shared. Every country in the mod is affected — edit with care.
globalExceptTitle: Global shared, except ({tags}). Editing affects every other country.
sectionAllHint: Showing entries from every country. The badge on each row shows which country it belongs to.
